label: For "Provider Network Attrition Prediction": Predict provider or group departures or reduced participation so network teams can plan retention and continuity, with explainable operational drivers and a retention workflow, and no punitive use. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Using the score in payment or contracting decisions.
